notes.title: Update Patch
notes.content:
[h1]Update Patch Notes[/h1]:

[b]V-Sync Activation:[/b]

V-Sync has been activated to improve image quality, removing screen tearing and other visual bugs. The synchronization will be based on the refresh rate (Hz) of your monitor for a smoother experience.

[b]Multi-Monitor Setup Fix:[/b]

We fixed an issue where players with more than one monitor experienced a problem when clicking outside the game window, which caused the HUD to freeze as if the game was paused and wouldn't resume. This has now been resolved.

[b]Health Bar Bug:[/b]

A bug where the player’s health became infinite or the health bar respawned empty has been fixed. The health bar now works correctly as intended.

[b]Save Notification Fix:[/b]

The save notification occasionally got stuck in the corner of the screen and wouldn’t disappear. This issue has been fixed.

[b]Save File Generation Issue:[/b]

There was a problem generating the save file, preventing the progress from being saved properly. The save system now works as expected.

[b]Control Mapping Update:[/b]

For players using laptops who had issues with the "Right Control" button to attack and enter stages, we have added the L key as an alternative to perform the same actions.


*If you have any problems playing, for example, not being able to move the player on the map screen, go back to the title screen, go to options and delete the save, you will not lose the achievement progress. This can happen due to the update of the save system.


Thank you very much.
